name: Possible Stroke (FAST signs)
description: Sudden onset right-sided facial drop and slurred speech
inputText: My mother suddenly cannot smile evenly, her right face is drooping and her speech became slurred 15 minutes ago.
notes: Time-sensitive neurological emergency. Immediate 112/emergency dispatch needed.

name: Severe Chest Pain (Possible Myocardial Infarction)
description: Crushing substernal pressure with left arm radiation and diaphoresis
inputText: Crushing heavy pressure in center of chest for past 20 minutes radiating to left arm and jaw, broke into cold sweat.
notes: Classic acute coronary syndrome presentation. High acuity emergency.

name: Severe Breathing Difficulty / Anoxia
description: Gasping for air, cyanosis, unable to speak full sentences
inputText: Struggling to breathe, gasping for air, lips are turning bluish and can only speak one word at a time.
notes: Imminent respiratory compromise. Immediate emergency care required.

name: Unresponsiveness / Stupor
description: Found on floor not waking up, barely breathing
inputText: Found my roommate unconscious on bedroom floor, not waking up when shaken, breathing is very slow.
notes: Comatose / unresponsive patient. Urgent airway and emergency evaluation.

name: Prolonged Seizure / Status Epilepticus
description: Continuous convulsive seizure lasting more than 5 minutes
inputText: My brother has been actively convulsing and shaking violently in a seizure for more than 6 minutes without stopping.
notes: Status epilepticus threshold (> 5 mins). Potential brain hypoxia.

name: Severe Arterial Bleeding
description: Pulsatile bright red blood from thigh wound not stopping with direct pressure
inputText: Sustained a deep power saw cut on upper thigh, spurting bright red blood profusely, blood soaking through heavy towels.
notes: Arterial bleed risk of hemorrhagic shock. Immediate pressure, tourniquet and 112.

name: Severe Anaphylaxis
description: Peanut ingestion followed by swollen tongue, throat tightness, and stridor
inputText: Accidentally ate peanut sauce, now tongue and throat are swelling rapidly, wheezing and dizzy.
notes: Acute airway obstruction danger. Epinephrine and emergency dispatch.

name: Suspected Toxic Ingestion / Overdose
description: Ingested bottle of drain cleaner with severe burning
inputText: Toddler accidentally swallowed a mouthful of industrial chemical drain cleaner, crying and vomiting blood.
notes: Caustic ingestion. Do not induce vomiting, immediate emergency medical attention.

name: Major Trauma / Spinal / Head Injury
description: Fall from height with loss of consciousness and visible limb deformity
inputText: Fell 12 feet from terrace ladder, hit head hard with brief blackout, right leg has bone visibly protruding.
notes: Open compound fracture and head trauma. Immobilize and dispatch ambulance.

name: Obstetric Emergency (Third Trimester)
description: 34 weeks pregnant with sudden severe abdominal pain and heavy bright red bleeding
inputText: I am 34 weeks pregnant and suddenly having excruciating continuous belly pain with heavy bright red bleeding.
notes: Possible placental abruption / preterm emergency. Immediate obstetric emergency.

name: Severe Extensive Burns
description: Large boiling oil splash over face, neck, and upper chest with blistering
inputText: Deep pressure cooker boiling oil explosion all over face, neck and chest, skin peeling away with severe white patches.
notes: Inhalation and third-degree burn hazard. Emergency burn center care.

name: Immediate Self-Harm / Crisis
description: Active thoughts of suicide with immediate plan and means
inputText: I feel completely hopeless, have pills in my hand right now and want to end my life tonight.
notes: Crisis intervention priority. Display immediate tele-manas / 112 / crisis helpline.

name: Negation Test 1 (Mild Headache, NO Chest Pain)
description: User explicitly denies red flags while reporting a routine headache
inputText: I have had a mild dull headache behind my eyes for 2 days. I have NO chest pain, NO shortness of breath, and no numbness.
notes: CRITICAL TEST: Parser must recognize negation ('NO chest pain') and NOT trip cardiac red flag.

name: Negation Test 2 (Grandmother Fatigue, Denies Dyspnea)
description: Elderly fatigue with explicit absence of acute respiratory compromise
inputText: My 76-year-old grandmother is feeling worn out and needs help walking to bathroom. Denies chest pain, denies trouble breathing.
notes: Caregiver matching is appropriate. Red-flag rules must respect negative assertions.

name: Hindi Acute Emergency (Chest Pain)
description: Acute chest pain and profuse sweating described in Hindi
inputText: छाती में बहुत तेज दर्द हो रहा है, सांस लेने में तकलीफ है और बहुत ज्यादा पसीना आ रहा है।
notes: Hindi text must trigger deterministic red flag for acute chest distress.

name: Hindi Routine Care (Cold/Sore Throat)
description: Mild upper respiratory symptoms in Hindi without emergency features
inputText: मुझे दो दिन से हल्की सर्दी, छींकें और गले में खराश है। कोई सांस की तकलीफ या सीने में दर्द नहीं है।
notes: Routine primary care recommendation with safe self-care guidance.

name: Hinglish Non-Clinical Elder Assistance
description: Elderly mobility and daily routine care in Hinglish
inputText: Dadaji ko chalne firne me support chahiye aur daily routine help chahiye, koi medical emergency nahi hai.
notes: Eligible for non-clinical caregiver matching.

name: Urgent Medical (Cut Needing Stitches)
description: Clean kitchen laceration stopped bleeding, needs suturing within hours
inputText: Kitchen knife sliced my thumb 1 hour ago. Bleeding has stopped with pressure, but the cut is gaping open about 2cm.
notes: Not an immediate 112 life-threat, but requires in-person urgent clinic visit within 4-6 hours for closure.

name: Routine Doctor Visit (Persistent Rash)
description: Mild itchy circular dry skin patch on forearm for 2 weeks
inputText: Dry itchy red patch on forearm for 2 weeks, not spreading quickly, no fever, no swelling.
notes: Recommend scheduled dermatologist or family clinician consultation.

name: Self-Monitoring (Minor Muscle Soreness)
description: Biceps stiffness after first gym workout in months
inputText: Mild bicep muscle soreness 24 hours after lifting gym weights for first time. No swelling, no dark urine.
notes: Reassuring guidance with advice to consult clinician if pain worsens or symptoms change.
